blurb: Guests charter private boats and yachts for bespoke day trips, sunset cruises, and special events around Newport, Narragansett Bay, and nearby destinations like Block Island and the Hamptons. The fleet includes a variety of vessels from fast dayboats to luxury yachts and sailing catamarans. Charters include a captain and can be customized with provisions and routes as desired by the guest.
extraNote: $100 admin fee on some charters · Gratuity not included · Fuel cost separate from charter price · Captain cost included in some prices, separate in others
